title: Amazingly Comforting Japanese Potatoes Agedashi
description: A comforting Japanese dish featuring charlotte potatoes in a crispy agedashi form, served with a rich coconut cream crack sauce, perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: charlotte potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into large chunks

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
Toss the potato chunks in the flour mixture to coat, shaking off excess.
Carefully add the coated potatoes to the hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the potatoes from the oil and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut cream, soy sauce, and rice vinegar to make the crack sauce.
To assemble, place a few pieces of the fried potato in a raclette grill vessel, top with a spoonful of the coconut cream crack sauce, and serve immediately.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions, if desired.
Repeat the process with the remaining potato chunks and sauce.
